positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on complex, customizable frontend applications using Javascript, Node.js, Vue, and Ember 🐹

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Provided software support to customers with an emphasis on customer retention, relationship-building, and education; primary contact for customers using integrations with partner software.
•	Exercised administrator role for Nvoicepay applications, using in-house utility applications built on Azure services to configure new accounts and correct payment errors.
•	Conducted remote one-on-one and small group trainings with end users. Consistently received excellent ratings from attendee surveys. 
•	Configured software integrations with CDK Global, Yooz, and Great Plains. 
•	Identified bugs and collaborated closely with QA team on new features.

positions.title: Vendor Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Provided B2B payment support to corporate clients and payment recipients using in-house software.
•	Prepared detailed presale reports for Sales department based on potential customer MasterCard volume.
•	Held leadership role in evaluating and adopting ABBYY optical reader software to automate form processing.
•	Selected for a more technical role within a year.

positions.title: International Visitor Leadership Program Intern
positions.description:
•	Drafted proposals to procure a Portland stop on U.S. Department of State International Visitor Leadership Program (IVLP) professional development tours with a high rate of acceptance.
•	Researched local professional resources for delegates and proposed agendas for free time.
